news.headline: Broadcom Redraws the AI Silicon Runway While Dell's 16% Sprint Pulls Wall Street Off the Mat
news.summary: Wall Street clawed back ground on Wednesday as long yields eased and Dell exploded 16% higher on the AI-server print. After the close, Broadcom lifted its FY27 AI revenue outlook to roughly $115 billion and, for the first time, put a $230 billion number on FY28. Snowflake set up a 20% pre-market gap on its own guidance raise.
